repairs.issue: ast.dump was called on decorator_list lists
repairs.resolution: Each decorator AST node is dumped individually and tuples of dumps are compared.

repairs.issue: Repository-suite commands did not bind or assert candidate origins and referenced temporary packet paths
repairs.resolution: Commands use durable e4v3 paths, candidate PYTHONPATH and isolated NUMBA_CACHE_DIR; package, math-profile and wall-shadow origins are asserted in the same process before pytest.main.

repairs.issue: Same-stamp invalidation covered wall kernels but not math entrypoints
repairs.resolution: Three math cases mutate _sleef_acos.py, _sleef_classifier.py, and shared _jit_cache.py while preserving size and mtime. Expected changed entrypoint sets are respectively asvf_fma; tan_array plus atan_array; and all three.

math_same_stamp_obligations: only the expected qualified namespaces change
affected cache artifacts miss and save under new names
unaffected entrypoints load their existing cache artifacts
mutated warm outputs equal original outputs and independent mutated-cold outputs
mutated warm namespaces and fingerprint equal independent mutated-cold
